title: Hotel Rate Plans: What Each Plan Takes at Booking
content:
What a Hotel Rate Plans reservation takes at booking is fixed by the plan: some plans take the whole stay, the rest take a deposit measured in room nights.

| Rate plan | Whole stay taken at booking | Share of the room total taken at booking, percent | Room nights taken as a deposit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | yes | 100 | 0 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | yes | 100 | 0 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | no | 25 | 1 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | no | 0 | 1 |
| Member Flex Rate | no | 0 | 1 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | no | 0 | 2 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 100 | 0 |

## The three figures

- **Whether the whole stay is taken at booking** distinguishes the prepaid plans from the rest.
- **The share of the room total taken at booking** is a percentage of the room total. The Semi-Flexible Rate is the only plan that takes a part share, 25 percent, without taking the whole stay.
- **The room nights taken as a deposit** is the number of nights taken where no full prepayment is required. The Suite Flexible Rate takes 2; the Semi-Flexible Rate, the Standard Flexible Rate and the Member Flex Rate take 1; the three prepaid plans take 0.

## A question the schedule answers

*Which plans show a share of 0 percent and still take money at booking?* The Standard Flexible Rate and the Member Flex Rate record a share of 0 percent, so nothing is taken as a share of the room total, and each records 1 room night taken as a deposit. On a hypothetical nightly room rate of 220.00 USD, one room night comes to 220.00 USD on either plan.
